Now I am not programer , but I could create cards games py just papers , so some of technology was good to raise creativity , but when I laked it , I was allowed to raise my mind to count on it self to find a way for intertainment far from technology , which made my mind able to use the creativity , and to use technology tro creatre 3d works , but if I was only depend on technology in playing like now , I would gain creativity , then loasing it , because what you o not have time nor chance to use is useless .

description_text:
This is my version of the Beskar spear from the Disney Tv show The Mandalorian.
The spear is split to be easily printed with no supports on beds 220 and bigger
I made the spear to slide together with a 5/8" wooden dowel rod or print out the insert to slide between each piece. 
This Spear should print just fine standing up with zero supports on a 300x300 bed.
I tried to make this as close as possible size wise to the screen used. They Used two different sized spears, one for show and one for fighting or having it strapped to his back. Since this model slides together, it is super easy to swap out some of the longer pieces with shorter so you can adjust the length to exactly what you need.
Please, Do not share/resale the 3d model
I don't mind selling of the prints as long as GrizzlyMountainDesigns is refered as the modeler :) Please feel free to message with any other questions or reguests!
For even better deals, check out our patreon at patreon.com/grizzlymountaindesigns
If you like my designs/models check out our instagram Grizzlymountaindesigns or for even better deals then on here join the patreon, same name!
I do custom models so let me know if there's anything you think would be a good hit!

description_text:
Kids Wagon 3D model collection that I made using Blender. This collection includes both versions of the model. Both versions of the model can be used in game development, scenes, animations and more.
Features:

  - Includes 2 models

  - Models use the metalness workflow and 4K PBR textures in PNG format

  - Textures can be edited and downscaled

  - Models have been manually UV unwrapped

  - Includes textures for each model version

  - Includes exports with different handle positions

  - Includes exports with wheels and handle separated for animating

  - Origins properly placed for separated meshes

  - Blend file includes pre-applied textures as well as camera setups

  - Lighting provided by the included HDRi map downloaded from HDRi Haven

  - Models have been exported in 4 file formats (FBX, OBJ, GLTF/GLB, DAE/Collada)

  - Includes GLTF file type instructions

  - Files have been archived in an easy-to-follow hierarchy

  - Images were rendered using the Cycles engine

  - Wireframes were rendered inside of Blender

Included Textures:

  - AO, Diffuse, Roughness, Gloss, Metallic

  - UVLayout

3D Model of a Futuristic Robot
Complex model of a futuristic-looking robot. The high-poly character has multiple details and mechanisms to simulate a realistic appearance.
The joints of the robot were created in such a way that the limbs can be moved without colliding with the rest of the mesh.
The model has a combination of UV textures and PBR textures, in order to obtain the best visual results.
An extra .rar file with the textures only is also included.
The model is ready to be rigged -the pose the robot has above is only for the preview images-.

Accurate 3d model of the blood vessels of the brain.The Circle of Willis (also called Willis' Circle, Loop of Willis, cerebral arterial circle, and Willis Polygon) is a circulatory anastomosis that supplies blood to the brain and surrounding structures. It is named after Thomas Willis (1621–1675), an English physician.
The Circle of Willis is a part of the cerebral circulation and is composed of the following arteries:
    Anterior cerebral artery (left and right)    Anterior communicating artery    Internal carotid artery (left and right)    Posterior cerebral artery (left and right)    Posterior communicating artery (left and right)    Basilar artery
The middle cerebral arteries, supplying the brain, are not considered part of the circle.

description_text:
The Smiley Character Set models are low poly, with body rigged for simple animation. Animated and non-animated models are provided in DAE and FBX formats. Unrigged models are also provided in OBJ format.
A video clip demonstrating animation can be viewed on Youtube - http://youtu.be/UmMuWGu0C1Q 
The Smiley Character Set models are UV mapped in 2048 X 2048 pixels. UV maps are provided for bodies and faces. You can change the Smiley faces and clothing by editing UVs in a paint app to create your own unique boy and girl Smiley characters. Just create folders for each of your customized models and replace the original texture files with your own designs.
In pre-release testing, FBX models functioned well in Unreal Engine 4. DAE models functioned in Vue. However, material transparency may need to be reset to 0% in some apps. FBX Review did not recognize the DAE animation, but did recognize animation in FBX models. All 3 formats require mesh smoothing, because they are low poly.

description_text:
Base mesh of a human female with Superhero proportions. It serves as a good starting point for creation of heroic body type man. Simply modify anatomy to your liking and add the desired accessories. 
Features:

  - ZBrush and Blender files for multilevel sculpting

  - Efficient and clean topology

  - Unwrapped UV’s (check images in the gallery for your reference)

  - 5 levels of Subdivision 

  - Organized polygroups for easy part isolation

  - Hair placeholder (decimated)

  - Arms Down/Legs Together/Heels pose on separate layers

  - Real world scale (6 feet or 182 cm)

  - Polygon count – 18002 at lowest subdivision

  - Pre-baked Normal Map Texture can be applied onto low-poly mesh

Package includes:

  - Zbrush model (5 levels of subdivisions)

  - Blender scene (5 levels of subdivisions)

  - OBJ (level1, level2)

  - FBX (level1, level2)

  - Normal Map Texture (PNG 4096x4096)

PRINTER SETTINGS
 As the helmet is quite big, it is meant to be post-processed. We recommend a layer height of 0.1 to 0.3 mm on FDM printers. All parts are aligned to the printing platform for easy manipulation. For reliable printing, we also recommend setting a brim to the helmets shell parts, because of their height and low thickness. It will ensure, that the parts will not come off the printing platform during the printing process. Printing settings will vary greatly depending on your specific printer.

description_text:
Hail Brethren!
Your journey has become more perilous...
You may have created your band of brave heroes, but they have yet to face a real challenge. A worthy adversary has appeared, in the form of the Shard Saga: Enemy Goblin Pack.
The Shard Saga: Enemy Goblin Pack contains the same unique art style as our Heroes and Dungeons pack. The color palette, poly fidelity, ease of use, and creativity are all here. Keeping in line with the customization our other Shard Saga packs offer, we have gone ahead and included multiple head/helm combinations, skin colors, and weapons.
This pack contains a crazy amount of customization potential, similar to our Heroes Pack. You will be able to mix and match a variety of bodies, heads and weapons to create tons of goblin types.
15 Body Meshes

  - 5 Armor Types

  - 3 Color Variations

18 Head Meshes

  - 5 Helmet Types

  - 1 Head Mesh

  - 3 Color Variations

8 Weapon Meshes

  - Two Handed Axe

  - Two Handed Spear

  - Sacrificial Dagger

  - Voo Doo Offhand

  - One Handed Sword

  - One Handed Axe

  - Staff

  - Shield

  - 3 Color Variations

Included in this pack are the highly requested Two Handed animations, and a new caster weapon + off hand combo. You can use animations from any of the Shard Saga packs to animate your goblins, including allow them to use weapon types from other packages. The included animations work on our Shard Saga rig, so they can be played on any previously purchased characters, and are guaranteed to work on all future installments too.
3 New Animation Sets

  - 8 Animations Each

  - Two Handed Weapons

  - Compatible With All Shard Saga Packs

And remember, No Textures! That's right, everything in this pack is vertex color and uses only one material making sure performance is never an issue.
Do you have suggestions for future packs in the Shard Saga universe? Email us at our Contact Page or feel free to tweet us @MutinyBros #ShardSaga
Mutiny Bros. Appreciates Your Dedication.

description_text:
This is my version of a male and female basemeshes (hopefully) realistic bodies. Both models are skinned and they're provided with a simple but functional rig. 

  - Avalaible as Blender project (.blend), Collada (.dae), and FBX (.fbx).

  - Models are provided with gums, teeth and tongues. A very basic eye-mesh is included.

  - The models are Uvmapped (non-overlapping). I'm currently working on textures for these models.

  - Before asking/purchasing: the models are not properly low poly (neither high), but they are highly optimized to work fluently, so don't panic about the polycount. Unsubdivided version of the models are available if needed, but I must to warn you that the models will appear blocky and less polished as they are by default. Each model count approximately 62'000 vertices. Also, don't be afraid to ask for any info or issue you might occur, I'll be glad to help and answer to the best of my abilities.

NOTE The bathsuit/underwear meshes are only intended as a censorship for the thumbnails. They're included in the package, but they're not linked to the models, nor to the rig. They're quite useless, so feel free to delete them if you wish.EDIT Now models are provided with unpolished, rather basic textures and materials: they can be used as a draft for you, if willing to - to make better textures out of them. I'm not expert/competent with textures yet, so bear with me. I might update them with better ones in the future.
Thanks for the support.

description_text:
Leg and foot bones human anatomy 3D Model. 5 individual objects (femur, fibula, foot, patella, tibia) sharing the same non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
5 Objects (meshes), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 9047 vertices, 8987 quad faces (17974 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
This is a 3d scanned model made with photogrammetry technique in our own custom built 3D scanner equipped with Canon 200D cameras. 
This is a true human size and detailed model of a sporty beautiful young woman of Caucasian appearance. The model is captured in casual pose to be perfectly matching for variety of architectural visualizations, e.g. sport ground, gym, beach, etc. . The product is ready for immediate use in architectural visualisations, for further render and detailed sculpting in Zbrush.
Technical characteristics:

  - digital double scan model

  - decimated model (100k triangles) 

  - sufficiently clean

  - PBR textures 8K diffuse, normal, specular maps 

  - non-overlapping UV map

Download package includes Cinema 4D project file with Redshift shader, as well as OBJ, FBX files, which are applicable to 3ds Max, Maya, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc. All the textures you may find in Tex folder, included into the main archive. 
BONUS: in this package you will also get a high-poly (.ztl tool) clean and retopologized automatically via ZRemesher 3d model in zBrush, thus you’ll be able to make a super-cool editing of the purchased product.
ABOUT US: we are photogrammetry studio based in Kyiv, passionate about 3D world. We do full body scanning, 3D scanning for VFX and Gaming, as well as post-production, including model clean-up and rigging, hair and clothes reconstruction and simulation, deep PBR texturing, set of expressions ready for blending. Most of all we love to create a character from scratch. We transform your idea into high quality animation-ready 3D model with PBR texture set. So stay tuned and follow us! 
More scans released every week!
3D EVERYTHING

description_text:
This is a 3d scanned model made with photogrammetry technique in our own custom built  3D scanner equipped with Canon 200D cameras. This scan was processed through Reality Capture and retopologized automatically via ZRemesher within Zbrush.
This is a true human size and detailed model of military knee pads in khaki. The product is ready for immediate use in architectural visualisations, for further render and detailed sculpting in Zbrush.
Technical characteristics:

  - digital double scan model

  - low-poly model

  - fully quad topology

  - sufficiently clean

  - ready for subdivision

  - 8K texture color map 

  - non-overlapping UV map

  - PBR textures 4K/2K resolution: Normal, Displacement, Albedo maps

Download package includes OBJ and FBX files, which is applicable to 3ds Max, Maya, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc.
BONUS: in this package you will also get a high-poly (.ztl tool) of raw 3d scanned model in zBrush, thus you’ll be able to make a super-cool editing of the purchased product.
ABOUT US: we are photogrammetry studio based in Kyiv, passionate about 3D world.  We do full body scanning, 3D scanning for VFX and Gaming, as well as post-production, including model clean-up and rigging, hair and clothes reconstruction and simulation, deep PBR texturing, set of expressions ready for blending. Most of all we love to create a character from scratch. We transform your idea into high quality animation-ready 3D model with PBR texture set. So stay tuned and follow us! 
More scans released every week!
3D EVERYTHING

The models are solid, and the scale can be easily modified to suit your printing needs. 
If the scaling is too small in your slicer when you open the file, just go to the scaling and change the 100% to 1000%, so it scales it up 10 fold. For some reason some slicers don't understand the scale correctly that has been created with blender.
The scale of the unified ribcage/spine model is: X75mm  Y52.7mm  Z150mm
You can print the model as a solid piece, or in parts. The ribs have concave slots that conform to the spine at the corresponding level.
The dimension are now set that one can print the unified model in upright position with an Anycubic photon S printer, which is the one I use most.
Included files are:

  - Unified ribcage and spine

  - Spine

description_text:
This is a life size 3d digital model of a Sphynx Cat Bust. OBJ, ZTL, PLY, FBX and STL files. parts is seperated.
The Sphynx cat is a breed of cat known for its lack of coat (fur). Hairlessness in cats is a naturally occurring genetic mutation; however, the Sphynx cat, as a breed, was developed through selective breeding, starting in the 1960s.[1] The skin should have the texture of chamois leather, as it has fine hairs, or the cat may be completely hairless. Whiskers may be present, either whole or broken, or may be totally absent. The cats have a narrow, long head and webbed feet. Their skin is the color that their fur would be, and all the usual cat markings (solid, point, van, tabby, tortie, etc.) may be found on the Sphynx cat's skin. Because they have no fur they lose more body heat than coated cats which makes them warm to the touch and prone to finding warm places.

description_text:
Hi I am Frezzy from Vnvisual studio.
+++++++++++++++BEFORE YOU MAKE PURCHASE:

  - My models are built on sizes and images from the internet. Therefore it will not be absolutely accurate compared to the real model.

  - If you cannot find the format that you need, contact me before purchasing or reviewing the product. I will assist you, including the refunds.

  - For formats where the model is not subdivision yet, don't worry, contact me and I'll help you with that.

  - Because of the different time zones, my response time is usually 12 hours. Please be patient. I will respond as quickly as possible.

+++++++++++++++Features:

  - High quality polygonal model. Mesh and details are built by our professional artists.

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied.

  - All textures and materials are included and mapped in every format.

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

+++++++++++++++File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2018 + V-Ray ( 3.6 ) and standard materials scenes

  - OBJ 2018 (Multi Format)

  - 3DS 2018 (Multi Format)

  - FBX 2018 (Multi Format)

  - Maya 2018 with standard materials

  - Cinema 4D R20 with standard materials

  - Blender 2.91( If you need other formats or lower version please contact me, I will export and setup for you. )

+++++++++++++++Textures: ( just for the models have textures, some models have not textures because it just contain base material )

  - High resolution ( up to 4096x4096 pixels for big parts and 2048x2048 pixels for small parts ).

  - If you need 8K or higher texture, please contact me.

  - About UVs: Some models have no UV if it has no texture (it only materials have no texture ). If you need UV for the models please contact me and I will help you.

+++++++++++++++

  - NOTE for Cinima 4D users: add HyperNURBS for each object to get subdivision ( smooth ). And make sure setting of HyperNURBS is Catmull-Clark and Subdivide UVs is Edge to correct textures and UVs.

  - NOTE: If you have problem with extract file please use latest version of winrar ( winrar is free )If you can't extract file, please contact me and I will help you.

+++++++++++++++About Vnvisual:We are a team of 3D artists with over a decade of experience in the field. My team participated in various projects allowing us to learn our clients needs.Every model we build goes through thorough quality assessment both visual and technical to make sure the assets look realistic and the models are of the best quality, which you can tell by looking at the renders none of the has any postprocessing.
  - Also check out our other models, just click on my user name to see complete gallery.

description_text:
---- SPECS ----
SchoolChair model is single combined object, parts are not welded so can be separated.
Master file is in Blend 2.79b file format, Preview images rendered in Blender with Cycle render engine.
3DsMax-Vray saved as 2015 version, FBX and OBJ file formats provided.
FBX and OBJ are exported from Blender, Only main model exported (Stage not included)
3DsMax-Vray file will render slight different.
Size Approx.
X: 30.229 cm
Y: 47.658 cm
Z: 35.453 cm
---- MATERIALS ----
Texture based PBR workflow used for main model.
Textures and HDRI Map included in FBX and OBJ zip, Textures are packed inside Blend file.
Textures are in PNG file format and all are 2K in size, use combinations as needed :-
SchoolChair_BaseColor.png
SchoolChair_Diffuse.png
SchoolChair_Emissive.png
SchoolChair_Glossiness.png
SchoolChair_ior.png
SchoolChair_Metallic.png
SchoolChair_Normal.png
SchoolChair_OcclusionRoughnessMetallic.png
SchoolChair_Opacity.png
SchoolChair_Reflection.png
SchoolChair_Roughness.png
SchoolChair_Specular.png
---- MATERIALS - Blender ----
Texture based Metalic PBR workflow used.
Principled BSDF used for Chair Model and Diffuse BSDF used for stage model
---- MATERIALS - 3Ds Max ----
Vray Mtl with PBR Textures used for main model
Vray Mtl with VrayColor used for background stage model
---- LIGHT ----
HDRI is the only light source, Mapping node used to rotate HDRI map.
georgentor_1k provided by HDRI Haven.
---- NOTE ----
Writing area have hinges attached, if there is no need of lifting writing pad then hinges can be removed resulting lighter model and possibly faster rendering.
---- SETUP - Blender ----
Textures and HDRI are packed in blend file
All keysfreames preserved so provided preview images can be recreated.
Stage model used for background and its provided with model.

description_text:
Paperplanes, ideal for your flightgame or as additional asset for you children based theme.
4 Paperplanes with one base texture
All four planes come in three UV-versions (hence 3 Meshes each):
  - overlap - contains the overlapping UVs + a Lightmap UV-Set in the second channel
  - overlap_noLightmapUVs has the second channel removed and therefore only features the overlap UV-set

  - non_overlap has the previous Lightmap UV as main UV-Set, while the overlap UV-Set got removed. For those versions an addition texture is containedIn case you want to make your own Texture Sets, the UV-Snapshot is included of all version.

All versions come as obj and fbx (2014/2015).
Pivots are alway in the Center down to the bottom. Exactly where a person would hold it, in case you want to attach it to an animation.
Geometry has thickness, folds are acutally modelled, no normal map is needed. Both sides are textured. (no alpha involved)
I hope you have fun with these paperplanes!

description_text:
This is a 3d scanned model made with photogrammetry technique in our own custom built 3D scanner equipped with Canon 200D cameras. 
This is a true human size and detailed model of a handsome young man of Caucasian appearance dressed in casual style with a smartphone. The model is captured in casual pose to be perfectly matching to variety of architectural visualization, background character, product visualization, e.g. advert banners, professional products/devices presentations, etc.
The product is ready for immediate use in architectural visualisations, for further render and detailed sculpting in Zbrush.
Technical characteristics:

  - digital double scan model

  - decimated model (100k triangles) 

  - sufficiently clean

  - PBR textures 8K diffuse, normal, specular maps 

  - non-overlapping UV map

Download package includes Cinema 4D project file with Redshift shader, as well as OBJ, FBX files, which are applicable to 3ds Max, Maya, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc. All the textures you may find in Tex folder, included into the main archive. 
BONUS: in this package you will also get a high-poly (.ztl tool) clean and retopologized automatically via ZRemesher 3d model in zBrush, thus you’ll be able to make a super-cool editing of the purchased product.
ABOUT US: we are photogrammetry studio based in Kyiv, passionate about 3D world. We do full body scanning, 3D scanning for VFX and Gaming, as well as post-production, including model clean-up and rigging, hair and clothes reconstruction and simulation, deep PBR texturing, set of expressions ready for blending. Most of all we love to create a character from scratch. We transform your idea into high quality animation-ready 3D model with PBR texture set. So stay tuned and follow us! 
More scans released every week!
3D EVERYTHING

description_text:
This is a 3d scanned model made with photogrammetry technique in our own custom built 3D scanner equipped with Canon 200D cameras.
This is a true human size and detailed model of a beautiful young woman of Caucasian appearance dressed in casual style on a skateboard. The model is captured in casual pose to be perfectly matching to variety of architectural visualization, background character, product visualization e.g. urban installations, city designs, outdoor design presentations etc.
The product is ready for immediate use in architectural visualisations, for further render and detailed sculpting in Zbrush.
Technical characteristics:

  - digital double scan model

  - decimated model (100k triangles)

  - sufficiently clean

  - PBR textures 8K diffuse, normal, specular maps

  - non-overlapping UV map

Download package includes Cinema 4D project file with Redshift shader, as well as OBJ, FBX files, which are applicable to 3ds Max, Maya, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc. All the textures you may find in Tex folder, included into the main archive.
BONUS: in this package you will also get a high-poly (.ztl tool) clean and retopologized automatically via ZRemesher 3d model in zBrush, thus youll be able to make a super-cool editing of the purchased product.
ABOUT US: we are photogrammetry studio based in Kyiv, passionate about 3D world. We do full body scanning, 3D scanning for VFX and Gaming, as well as post-production, including model clean-up and rigging, hair and clothes reconstruction and simulation, deep PBR texturing, set of expressions ready for blending. Most of all we love to create a character from scratch. We transform your idea into high quality animation-ready 3D model with PBR texture set. So stay tuned and follow us!
More scans released every week!
3D EVERYTHING

description_text:
Hi there! We are excited to present our new product. This is a 3d scanned model made with photogrammetry technique in our own custom built 3D scanner equipped with Canon 200D cameras.
Production: November, 2020
This is a true human size and detailed model of a young handsome man of Caucasian appearance dressed in casual style with cup of coffee. The model is captured in casual pose to be perfectly matching to variety of architectural visualization, background character, product visualization e.g. urban installations, city designs, outdoor design presentations, VR/AR content etc.
The product is ready both for immediate use in architectural visualisations, or further render and detailed sculpting in Zbrush.
Technical characteristics:

  - digital double 3d scan model

  - decimated model (100k triangles)

  - sufficiently clean

  - PBR textures: Diffuse, Normal, Specular maps

  - non-overlapping UV map

Download package includes Cinema 4D project file with Redshift shader, OBJ, FBX files, which are applicable for 3ds Max, Maya, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc. All the textures you will find in the Tex folder, included into the main archive.
BONUSE: in this package you will also get a high-poly (.ztl tool) clean and retopologized automatically via ZRemesher 3d model in zBrush, thus youll be able to make your own editing of the purchased 3d model.
ABOUT US: deep3dstudio is a 3d scanning studio based in Kyiv, Ukraine. We scan people, animals and objects. We also perform a full pipeline of post-production, including model clean-up and rigging, hair and clothes reconstruction and simulation, deep PBR texturing, face blendshapes and animations.
Thank you for your purchase, we hope this model will be useful for your project!
Feel free to contact us if facing any questions. Your feedback is highly appreciated!
New 3d models every day!

Hi I am Frezzy from Vnvisual studio.
+++++++++++++++BEFORE YOU MAKE PURCHASE:

  - My models are built on sizes and images from the internet. Therefore it will not be absolutely accurate compared to the real model.

+++++++++++++++Features:

  - High quality polygonal model. Mesh and details are built by our professional artists.

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied.

  - All textures and materials are included and mapped in every format.

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

+++++++++++++++File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2018 + V-Ray ( 3.6 ) and standard materials scenes

  - OBJ 2018 (Multi Format)

  - 3DS 2018 (Multi Format)

  - FBX 2018 (Multi Format)

  - Maya 2018 with standard materials

  - Cinema 4D R20 with standard materials

  - Blender 2.91( If you need other formats or lower version please contact me, I will export and setup for you. )

+++++++++++++++Textures: ( just for the models have textures, some models have not textures because it just contain base material )

  - High resolution ( up to 4096x4096 pixels for big parts and 2048x2048 pixels for small parts ).

  - If you need 8K or higher texture, please contact me.

  - About UVs: Some models have no UV if it has no texture (it only materials have no texture ). If you need UV for the models please contact me and I will help you.

+++++++++++++++

  - NOTE for Cinima 4D users: add HyperNURBS for each object to get subdivision ( smooth ). And make sure setting of HyperNURBS is Catmull-Clark and Subdivide UVs is Edge to correct textures and UVs.

  - NOTE: If you have problem with extract file please use latest version of winrar ( winrar is free )If you can't extract file, please contact me and I will help you.

My team participated in various projects allowing us to learn our clients needs.Every model we build goes through thorough quality assessment both visual and technical to make sure the assets look realistic and the models are of the best quality, which you can tell by looking at the renders none of the has any postprocessing.

+++++++++++++++BEFORE YOU MAKE PURCHASE:

  - My models are built on sizes and images from the internet. Therefore it will not be absolutely accurate compared to the real model.

  - If you cannot find the format that you need, contact me before purchasing or reviewing the product. I will assist you, including the refunds.

  - For formats where the model is not subdivision yet, don't worry, contact me and I'll help you with that. ( I will export and send to you high poly/ smooth version ).

  - Because of the different time zones, my response time is usually 12 hours. Please be patient. I will respond as quickly as possible.

+++++++++++++++Features:

  - High quality polygonal model. Mesh and details are built by our professional artists.

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

+++++++++++++++File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2018 + V-Ray ( 3.6 ) and standard materials scenes

  - OBJ 2018 (Multi Format)

  - 3DS 2018 (Multi Format)

  - FBX 2018 (Multi Format)

  - Maya 2018 with standard materials

  - Cinema 4D R20 with standard materials

  - Blender 2.91( If you need other formats or lower version please contact me, I will export and setup for you. )

+++++++++++++++Textures: ( just for the models have textures, some models have not textures because it just contain base material )

  - Models was textured will be seen in the preview image and the infobox next to it. Models have no texture just contain standard materials.For models have texture:

  - High resolution ( up to 4096x4096 pixels for big parts and 2048x2048 pixels for small parts ).

  - If you need 8K or higher texture, please contact me.

  - About UVs: Some models have no UV if it has no texture (it only materials have no texture ). If you need UV for the models please contact me and I will help you.

+++++++++++++++

  - NOTE for Cinima 4D users: add HyperNURBS for each object to get subdivision ( smooth ). And make sure setting of HyperNURBS is Catmull-Clark and Subdivide UVs is Edge to correct textures and UVs.

  - NOTE: If you have problem with extract file please use latest version of winrar ( winrar is free )If you can't extract file, please contact me and I will help you.

  - Also check out our other models, just click on my user name to see complete gallery.

description_text:
+++++++++++++++
BEFORE YOU MAKE PURCHASE:

  - My models are built on sizes and images from the internet. Therefore it will not be absolutely accurate compared to the real model.

  - If you cannot find the format that you need, contact me before purchasing or reviewing the product. I will assist you, including the refunds.

  - For formats where the model is not subdivision yet, don't worry, contact me and I'll help you with that. ( I will export and send to you high poly/ smooth version ).

  - Because of the different time zones, my response time is usually 12 hours. Please be patient. I will respond as quickly as possible.

+++++++++++++++
Features:

  - High quality polygonal model. Mesh and details are built by our professional artists.

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

+++++++++++++++
File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2018 + V-Ray ( 3.6 ) and standard materials scenes

  - OBJ 2018 (Multi Format)

  - 3DS 2018 (Multi Format)

  - FBX 2018 (Multi Format)

  - Maya 2018 with standard materials

  - Cinema 4D R20 with standard materials

  - Blender 2.91

( If you need other formats or lower version please contact me, I will export and setup for you. )
+++++++++++++++
Textures: ( just for the models have textures, some models have not textures because it just contain base material )
  - Models was textured will be seen in the preview image and the infobox next to it. Models have no texture just contain standard materials.
For models have texture:

  - High resolution ( up to 4096x4096 pixels for big parts and 2048x2048 pixels for small parts ).

  - If you need 8K or higher texture, please contact me.

  - About UVs: Some models have no UV if it has no texture (it only materials have no texture ). If you need UV for the models please contact me and I will help you.

+++++++++++++++

  - NOTE for Cinima 4D users: add HyperNURBS for each object to get subdivision ( smooth ). And make sure setting of HyperNURBS is Catmull-Clark and Subdivide UVs is Edge to correct textures and UVs.

  - NOTE: If you have problem with extract file please use latest version of winrar ( winrar is free )

If you can't extract file, please contact me and I will help you.
  - Also check out our other models, just click on my user name to see complete gallery.

description_text:
Cartoon Ghost is a high quality model to add more details and realism to your rendering projects. 
Models possible to use in any project. 
Originally modeled in cinema 4d, textured with substance painter and rendered with marmoset. 
********************************* 
Features: 
- High quality polygonal model - correctly scaled accurate representation of the original objects. 
- Model resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. 
- Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 
- All materials are included and mapped in every format. 
- No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene. 
- No cleaning up necessary, just drop your models into the scene and start rendering. 
- No special plugin needed to open scene.
********************************* 
Models: 
1 objects 1 Color Map texture: 
polygons: 3424 
points: 3502

File formats: 
- OBJ .
- 3DS .

-Stl.
Every model has been checked with the appropriate software. 
*********************************

Texture dim: (1024x1024) png. 
color map / metalness map / normal map / Roughness.
********************************* 
Hope you like it!

description_text:
The Master Sword,  also known as the Blade of Evil's Bane, the Legendary Sword, the Sword of Legend,  the Master Sword of Resurrection, the Sword that Seals the Darkness, and the Sacred Sword, is a recurring legendary Sword in the The Legend of Zelda series.
The Master Sword was originally crafted by the goddess Hylia as the Goddess Sword, and was later forged into the Master Sword by the Goddess's chosen hero and its spirit, Fi, who bathed it in the three Sacred Flames located across the land that would become the Kingdom of Hyrule. Din's Flame in particular imbued the sword with the Power to Repel Evil,  a power augmented after the Sword received the blessing of Zelda, which transformed the blade into the True Master Sword. It is usually the only Sword that can defeat Ganon in the games it appears in.

description_text:
A necklace is an article of jewellery that is worn around the neck. Necklaces may have been one of the earliest types of adornment worn by humans.[1] They often serve ceremonial, religious, magical, or funerary purposes and are also used as symbols of wealth and status, given that they are commonly made of precious metals and stones.
The main component of a necklace is the band, chain, or cord that wraps around the neck. These are most often rendered in precious metals such as gold, silver, and platinum. Necklaces often have additional attachments suspended or inset into the necklace itself. These attachments typically include pendants, lockets, amulets, crosses, and precious and semiprecious materials such as diamond, pearls, rubies, emeralds, garnets, and sapphires. They are made with many different type of materials and are used for many things and sometimes classified as clothing

description_text:
Bane's origin story is set in the story Knightfall. 6 His father, Edmund Dorrance (better known as the Serpent King), had been a revolutionary who had escaped the Santa Prisca court system. The corrupt government decreed that his young son would serve the man's life sentence, so Bane spent his childhood and early adult life in prison.3 7
Although he was imprisoned, his natural abilities allowed him to develop extraordinary abilities within the prison walls. He read as many books as he could, spent most of his free time as a bodybuilder in the prison gym, developed his own form of meditation, and learned to fight in the ruthless school of prison life. Due to the supposed geographic and cultural location of Santa Prisca, Bane could speak English, Spanish, Portuguese and Latin. Despite his circumstances, he encountered teachers of various sorts during his incarceration, from hardened convicts to an elderly Jesuit priest, under whose tutelage he apparently received a classical education. Bane murdered this priest on his return to Santa Prisca years later. He committed his first murder at the age of eight, stabbing a criminal who wanted to use him to obtain information about the prison.7 During his years in prison, Bane carried a teddy bear that he called Bear, whom he considered his only friend.8 It is revealed that Bear has a hole in his back to hold a knife that Bane used to defend himself

description_text: Fafnir, in Nordic mythology, name of the great dragon slain by Sigurd, the Norse version of the German hero Siegfreid. As told in the Volsunga saga, Fafnir slew his father, Hreithmar, to obtain the vast amount of gold which Hreithmar had demanded of Odin as a compensation for the loss of one of his sons. Odin gave the gold but put a curse on it. Full of greed, Fafnir changed into a dragon to guard his treasure and was later slain by the young hero Sigurd. Sigurd was spurred on by another brother of Fafnir, the blacksmith Regin. Once Sigurd, under the advice of Odin, had killed Fafnir, Regin asked him to cook the dragon’s heart for him. Sigurd touched the heart as it was cooking to test if it was done and burned his thumb. He put his thumb into his mouth and was then able to understand the language of birds. (In this tale, knowledge is given to one who eats the heart of a dragon.) The birds told Sigurd that it was Regin’s intention to kill him, so instead Sigurd killed Regin and left with Fafnir’s treasure.

description_text:
Ice houses were buildings used to store ice throughout the year, prior to the invention of the refrigerator. The most common designs involved underground chambers, usually man-made, which were built close to natural sources of winter ice such as freshwater lakes.
During the winter, ice and snow would be taken into the ice house and packed with insulation, often straw or sawdust. It would remain frozen for many months, often until the following winter, and could be used as a source of ice during summer months. This could be used simply to cool drinks, or allow ice-cream and sorbet desserts to be prepared.

description_text:
Unlike other foxes that roamed the woods of southern Ionia, Ahri had always felt a strange connection to the magical world around her; a connection that was somehow incomplete. Deep inside, she felt the skin she had been born into was an ill fit for her and dreamt of one day becoming human. Her goal seemed forever out of reach, until she happened upon the wake of a human battle. It was a grisly scene, the land obscured by the forms of wounded and dying soldiers. She felt drawn to one: a robed man encircled by a waning field of magic, his life quickly slipping away. She approached him and something deep inside of her triggered, reaching out to the man in a way she couldn't understand. His life essence poured into her, carried on invisible strands of magic. The sensation was intoxicating and overwhelming. As her reverie faded, she was delighted to discover that she had changed. Her sleek white fur had receded and her body was long and lithe - the shape of the humans who lay scattered about her.
However, though she appeared human, she knew that in truth the transformation was incomplete. A cunning creature, she adapted herself to the customs of human society and used her profound gift of beauty to attract unsuspecting men. She could consume their life essences when they were under the spell of her charms. Feeding on their desires brought her closer to her dream, but as she took more lives, a strange sense of regret began to well within her. She had reservations about actions which never troubled her as a fox. She realized that she could not overcome the pangs of her evolving morality. In search of a solution, Ahri found the Institute of War, home of the most gifted mages on Runeterra. They offered her a chance to attain her humanity without further harm through service in the League of Legends.
''Mercy is a human luxury... and responsibility.''-- Ahri

description_text:
Palazzo della Civiltà Italiana is an icon of Fascist architecture. Decidedly inspired by the 2000 year old elliptical amphitheatre, the Colosseum, Palazzo della Civiltà Italiana was intended by Benito Mussolini as a celebration of the older Roman landmark. The Palazzo della Civiltà Italiana, also known as the Palazzo della Civiltà del Lavoro or simply the Colosseo Quadrato (Square Colosseum), is an icon of Fascist architecture.
The building was designed in 1937 to host the Mostra della Civiltà Romana during the 1942 World Fair by Italian architects Giovanni Guerrini, Ernesto Bruno La Padula  and Mario Romano.
It lies in the district of Rome known as the Esposizione Universale Roma (also known as 'E.42' and 'EUR'). It is particularly symbolic of this district, exemplifying its monumentality.
The palace is entirely clad in travertine marble, as is characteristic of buildings in the EUR. It is a parallelepiped on a square base, with six levels rising above a podium. The scale is imposing: the base covers an area of 8,400 square meters, and the building has volume 205,000 cubic meters with a height 68 meters.
Because of its bold appearance and iconic status, the building has appeared in a number of films, including The Last Man on Earth, Hudson Hawk, Titus and Equilibrium.
From October 22, 2015 this monument has become the new headquarter of the famous fashion brand Fendi. 
Enjoy

description_text:
*Low Poly model of Imperial Japan WW2 Type 97 Chi Ha medium tank . *
Model contains real details and proportions. 2048x2048 textures included: -Color maps -psd (AO, decals on separated layers, specular on Alpha channel) 2k,1k (wheels) -Normal maps 2k,1k -Emission map for lights . Texture designed for scaling - great for mobile games.
The Type 97 Chi-Ha (九七式中戦車 チハ Kyūnana-shiki chū-sensha Chi-ha) was a medium tank used by the Imperial Japanese Army during the Second Sino-Japanese War, the Battles of Khalkhin Gol against the Soviet Union, and the Second World War. It was the most widely produced Japanese medium tank of World War II. The 57 mm main gun, designed for infantry support, was a carry over from the 1933 Type 89 medium tank. The suspension was derived from the Type 95 Ha-Go light tank, but used six road wheels instead of four. The 170 hp Mitsubishi air cooled diesel engine was a capable tank engine in 1938. The Type 97's low silhouette and semicircular radio antenna on the turret distinguished the tank from its contemporaries. After 1941, the tank was less effective than most Allied tank designs. In 1942, a new version of the Chi-Ha was produced with a larger three-man turret, and a high-velocity Type 1 47 mm tank gun. It was designated the Type 97-Kai or Type 97 Shinhoto Chi-Ha.

To cope with the additional weight, a new Maybach V12 HL 120TR with a Maybach Variorex 10 speed gearbox delivered 300 bhp to this new version. description_text:
MAN Truck designed from ground up for 3D Printing. Additional file formats or sizes available, just ask me :) Scale 1:87 & 1:72 available in downloads.
3D Print recommendations:
* 0.4mm maximum nozzle size to keep up with small details    * 0.2mm or smaller layer height     * PVA support highly recommended for easier support removal.
See full details about MAN KAT 1 on http://www.military-today.com/trucks/man_kat1_4x4.htm
The basic MAN KAT 1 trucks with 4x4 configuration has a 5 000 kg payload capacity. It comes with a general service troop/cargo body. It is used to carry troops and supply combat units with ammunition and other military supplies. The cargo area is covered with bows and canvas cover. The truck has a standard NATO towing hitch and can tow trailers and artillery pieces. It can tow loads even over rough terrain. This tactical truck can be also used for a number of other military applications, carry shelters and special equipment.
All MAN KAT 1 series trucks are fitted with the same forward control cab. It is entirely made of steel. The cab accommodates driver and 2 passengers. Separated windscreens are designed for easier replacement. Also these are installed vertically in order to minimize light reflections. A roof hatch with a machine gun mount was fitted as standard. Optional equipment includes an armored cab.
Vehicle is powered by a 12.7-liter MAN turbocharged diesel engine, developing 256 hp. Engine is mounted behind the cab. This feature allowed to reduce overall height of the vehicle. Engine is mated with a ZF manual gearbox. Vehicle has a permanent all-wheel drive. A winch was fitted as standard.

description_text:
Fat Man nuclear bomb (the one dropped on Nagasaki) 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons), no poles.
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.79 (Cycles materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles for Blender 3D 2.7x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.79)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.79 with Cycles materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons), no poles; 45760 vertices, 45306 quad faces (90612 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height);so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.79 + Cycles using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

Alien Facehugger - 3D Asset Kit PBR

A photorealistic facehugger alien, ready for games and VFX.This character comes in an easy to rig pose and has a 4k and 2k texture set.   - Metalness - PBR Metal/Roughness Workflow

  - Glossiness - PBR Specular/Glossiness Workflow, Wet + Standard

  - HDR environment 
Enjoy rendering!

description_text:
This is a 3d scanned model made with photogrammetry technique in our own custom built 3D scanner equipped with Canon 200D cameras. 
This is a true human size and detailed model of a beautiful young woman of Caucasian appearance dressed in a uniform of a surgical nurse. The model is captured in casual pose to be perfectly matching to variety of architectural visualization, background character, product visualization, e.g. advert banners, professional products/devices presentations, etc.
The product is ready for immediate use in architectural visualisations, for further render and detailed sculpting in Zbrush.
Technical characteristics:

  - digital double scan model

  - decimated model (100k triangles) 

  - sufficiently clean

  - PBR textures 8K diffuse, normal, specular maps 

  - non-overlapping UV map

Download package includes Cinema 4D project file with Redshift shader, as well as OBJ, FBX files, which are applicable to 3ds Max, Maya, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc. All the textures you may find in Tex folder, included into the main archive. 
BONUS: in this package you will also get a high-poly (.ztl tool) clean and retopologized automatically via ZRemesher 3d model in zBrush, thus you’ll be able to make a super-cool editing of the purchased product.
ABOUT US: we are photogrammetry studio based in Kyiv, passionate about 3D world. We do full body scanning, 3D scanning for VFX and Gaming, as well as post-production, including model clean-up and rigging, hair and clothes reconstruction and simulation, deep PBR texturing, set of expressions ready for blending. Most of all we love to create a character from scratch. We transform your idea into high quality animation-ready 3D model with PBR texture set. So stay tuned and follow us! 
More scans released every week!
3D EVERYTHING

Face the Daleks in your own fierce CGI battle sequences with this Steampunk Commander Dalek pack with added battle armour and battle damaged variants for only £10!

  - Easy to change between default and upgraded appearance with removable upgrades.

This model has been sculpted from scratch, and is meant to be a proxy as a Grey Knights Dread.
This model comes complete with:

  - A Grey Knights Dread

  - A base (suitable for 60mm base) 

  - A banner

  - All the weapons as shown in the images

  - Four different Purity Seals

Armaments
  - Nemesis Great Sword

  - Gatling Psilencer

  - Rocket Launcher

  - Missile Launchers

Printing GuideThis is scaled 1:1. 
I printed this on an AnyCubic Photon. The parts are sliced such that they would fit on the build plate. 
I used the Prusa Slicer for orientating the parts and generating supports. After that, I copied them into Chitubox to slice the files. The files then went through the Photon Validator.
I used Elegoo Grey at 0.05.

description_text:
Face the Daleks in your own fierce CGI battle sequences with this Steampunk Science Dalek with extra (removable) accessories, such as a power core, electromagnetic barrier, and extra lights on top of the dome, along with battle damaged variants for only £10!
You are free to use this for your commercial films/games so long as you credit me and provide a link to this page.
Textures only work on Blender as they are node setups. I'm working on a way to convert nodes into mapped image textures.

  - Comes in OBJ, FBX, and Collada (.dae) files and the default Blender file for the easier option to simply append the models or export in any desired format. (Blender 2.9 or above required.)

  - The Dalek is user-friendly, with a simple parenting system for posing and movement, this Dalek is more than ready for animating!

  - Colours generated with simple noise textures with a micro bump map for a more realistic shine. Have a black Dalek, a white Dalek, a purple Dalek! Any colour you desire!

  - Easy to change between default and upgraded appearance with removable upgrades.

description_text:
A rigged and animated robot with different states of decomposition (both blender procedural materials and textures).
The included blender materials are:

  - 3 for the body (whole, decomposed and decomposed with lighting)

  - 2 for the legs (whole and decomposed)

  - other for eyes, enviroment, ...

You can also easily change the values of procedural materials in the blend file if you want to customize them.
The texture pack is subdivided in 3 phases (like the material types), each containing:

  - 
baseColor texture (different options)

  - Roughness texture

  - Emission texture

  - Normal texture

This rigged model uses 2 animations:

  - Waiting

  - Walking

The model has a simple bone structure, making creating animation very easy.
This model includes the basic environment (the ventilation system, like in the photo).
Other infos:

  - Verticles: 41886

  - Faces: 42086

Texture scale: 2048x2048
Made with Blender 2.8.

  - FBX 2016: three files, open, closed egg, and another with a small animation.

Mazinger Z is an enormous super robot, constructed with a fictional metal called Super-Alloy Z (超合金Z, Chōgokin Zetto), which is forged from a new element (Japanium) mined from a reservoir found only in the sediment of Mt. Fuji, in Japan. The mecha was built by Professor Juzo Kabuto as a secret weapon against the forces of evil, represented in the series by the Mechanical Beasts of Dr. Hell. The latter was the German member of a Japanese archeological team, which discovered ruins of a lost pre-Grecian civilization on an island named Bardos, the Mycéne Empire. One of their findings was that the Mycene used an army of steel titans about 20 meters in height. Finding prototypes of those titans underground which could be remote-controlled and realizing their immense power on the battlefield, Dr. Hell goes insane and has all the other scientists of his research team killed except for Professor Kabuto, who manages to escape. The lone survivor goes back to Japan and attempts to warn the world of its imminent danger. Meanwhile, Dr. Hell establishes his headquarters on a mobile island, forms the new Underground Empire, and plans to use the Mechanical Monsters to become the new ruler of the world. To counter this, Kabuto constructs Mazinger Z and manages to finish it just before being killed by a bomb planted by Hell's right-hand person, Baron Ashura, a half-man, half-woman. As he lays dying, he manages to inform his grandson Koji Kabuto about the robot and its use. Koji becomes the robot's pilot, and from that point on battles both the continuous mechanical monsters, and the sinister henchmen sent by Doctor Hell.

description_text:
Clone heavy trooper :“I am new here. I am a regular heavy trooper! My armor is clear my weapon is new, but i’m ready to make my hands dirty and fight for the republic! With me you can make amazing projects,
It was made in 3ds max, zbrush and in substance painter . It is based on the star wars classic battlefront 2 clone trooper phase 1.All details was captured from the original version what was on kamino in the movie. With the clear nice quality you can make amazing projects, videos, and more.

  - It is rigged so you can easly pose it, also i added a base rocket launcher reload animation

  - It is ready for cinemas, renders, or other projects that you like!

  - It has a good low poly topology that allow you for use it in small projects too

Everything is in the zip file: You will find it!
What will you get ? 

  - 1 rigged clone trooper

  - 1 rigged skirt

  - 1 rigged pauldron

  - 1 attached binocular

  - 1 rigged pistol holder

  - 1 geonosis rock

  - 1 rock

  - 1 ground 

  - 1 rigged rocketlauncher

Files

  - Rigged version in FBX file ( required minimum 2016 )

  - Textures in PNG format

Material: 

  - clone trooper (3)

  - rock (1)

  - rocketlauncher (1)

  - geonosis rock (1)

  - skirt (1)

  - ground (1)

  - binocular+pistol holder+binocular (1)

High quality PBR 2 (2048x2048) textures for save space and time and get good quality!
7 texture maps

  - Albedo

  - Rougness

  - Metallic

  - AO

  - Specular

  - Normal (Directx)

  - Emissive

You can import it in to and it is compatible with:

  - Blender

  - Unreal Engine

  - Unity

  - Cinema 4D

  - 3ds max

  - Maya

  - Substance painter

  - and many more other programs that is using fbx file

  - Check my other models here on the page->   https://www.cgtrader.com/designers/intergalacticsupplyyard

  - If you have any question or wish, i feel free to assist you:)  

  - Just write on discord:->    thomastheherooftherepublic4114 

  - or instagram ->  https://www.instagram.com/intergalactic_supply_yard/

Have a nice day:)

  - .blend1 (a .blend file backup)

3D MODEL DETAILS:

  - Animated - No

  - Rigged - Yes

  - VR/AR/Low-Poly - Yes

  - PBR - Yes

  - Geometry - Polygon Mesh

  - Polygons - 35,103

  - Vertices - 37,100

  - Textures - Yes 

  - Materials - Yes

  - UV Mapping - Yes 

  - Unwrapped UVs - Overlapping

  - Plugins Used - No 

TEXTURES:

  - The model has high-quality textures with a resolution (2048 x 2048), (1024 x 1024), (512 x 512).

  - Textures are saved in PNG formats.

  - Textures are collected in one archive and are delivered in separate file.

MATERIALS:
Materials for this 3D model are made in the Blender.
If you need to change the size of the model or change anything in it, you can upload it to any 3D package and scale it as you like (many formats are included, such as: .dae, .obj, .fbx, etc.) or you can do it in your software that supports 3D model formats. Preview images are rendered in Cycles Render.
I am happy to answer any questions you might have about the model.

description_text:
This is a 3d scanned model of a basic white male tank top, made with photogrammetry technique in our own custom built 3D scanner equipped with Canon 200D cameras. This scan was processed through Reality Capture and retopologized automatically via ZRemesher within Zbrush.
This is a true human size and detailed model of a white tank top of size S, M, L. May be slightly adjusted for better fitting.
The product is ready for immediate use in architectural visualisations, for further render and detailed sculpting in Zbrush.
Technical characteristics:

  - digital double scan model

  - low-poly model

  - fully quad topology

  - sufficiently clean

  - ready for subdivision

  - 8K texture color map

  - non-overlapping UV map

  - BPR textures: Normal, Displacement, Albedo maps

Download package includes OBJ and FBX files, which is applicable to 3ds Max, Maya, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc.
BONUS: in this package you will also get a high-poly (.ztl tool) of raw 3d scanned model in zBrush, thus you’ll be able to make a super-cool editing of the purchased product.
ABOUT US: we are photogrammetry studio based in Kyiv, passionate about 3D world. We do full body scanning, 3D scanning for VFX and Gaming, as well as post-production, including model clean-up and rigging, hair and clothes reconstruction and simulation, deep PBR texturing, set of expressions ready for blending. Most of all we love to create a character from scratch. We transform your idea into high quality animation-ready 3D model with PBR texture set. So stay tuned and follow us!
More scans released every week!
3D EVERYTHING

description_text:
This is a 3d scanned model made with photogrammetry technique in our own custom built 3D scanner equipped with Canon 200D cameras. 
This is a true human size and detailed model of a beautiful young woman of Caucasian appearance dressed in a uniform of a surgical nurse. The model is captured in casual pose to be perfectly matching to variety of architectural visualization, background character, product visualization, e.g. advert banners, professional products/devices presentations, etc.
The product is ready for immediate use in architectural visualisations, for further render and detailed sculpting in Zbrush.
Technical characteristics:

  - digital double scan model

  - decimated model (100k triangles) 

  - sufficiently clean

  - PBR textures 8K diffuse, normal, specular maps 

  - non-overlapping UV map

Download package includes Cinema 4D project file with Redshift shader, as well as OBJ, FBX files, which are applicable to 3ds Max, Maya, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc. All the textures you may find in Tex folder, included into the main archive. 
BONUS: in this package you will also get a high-poly (.ztl tool) clean and retopologized automatically via ZRemesher 3d model in zBrush, thus you’ll be able to make a super-cool editing of the purchased product.
ABOUT US: we are photogrammetry studio based in Kyiv, passionate about 3D world. We do full body scanning, 3D scanning for VFX and Gaming, as well as post-production, including model clean-up and rigging, hair and clothes reconstruction and simulation, deep PBR texturing, set of expressions ready for blending. Most of all we love to create a character from scratch. We transform your idea into high quality animation-ready 3D model with PBR texture set. So stay tuned and follow us! 
More scans released every week!
3D EVERYTHING

description_text:
Joséphine Aube Printanière solitaire
Parisian jeweller and temple of the tiara, xaumet has shrunk the diamond headpieces for which it is renowned down to finger-sized proportions. xaumet's tiara making was at its peak during the Belle Epoque era, towards the end of the 19th century, and it still takes special commissions for this classic piece of bridal wear at its boutique at No 12 Place Vendome. You may not be wearing a tiara on your wedding day, but you will feel every inch the modern-day princess in xaaumet's new Joséphine Tiara engagement ring, which is fully pavéd with brilliant-cut diamonds, framing that perfect pear-cut white diamond. Hi there, this is my original female character base mesh for ZBrush PLUS 

  - Polygon strips for her hair and eyebrows, surface for eyelashes, eyeballs, teeth, tongue, and clothing.

  - Marmoset Toolbag scene for look development.

  - Marvelous Designer avatar with arrangement points & garment files.

  - blender file for Rigging generated from Auto-Rig Pro Smart feature.

  - rig tools add-on and proxy_picker.py for blender (only to ensure the IK snaps and other rig functions).

-----Specification-----

  - Already retopologized sculpt-friendly base mesh from SDiv1 (5,490 verts) to SDiv4 (351,810 verts)

  - UV unwrapped and PBR textures for

  - BodyLow (5,490 verts) 2k normal, albedo, roughness

  - BodyHigh (21,990 verts) 4k normal, albedo, roughness

  - Clothing (936 verts) 1k normal, albedo, roughness

  - TeethGumTongue (4,061 verts) 1k albedo, roughness

  - Eyeball (2,216 verts) 1k albedo

  - EyebrowEyelashHair (21,175 verts) 4k albedo, alpha

-----Note-----

  - rig tools add-on for blender you can use only to ensure the IK snaps and other rig functions. It doesn't include Auto-Rig Pro add-on itself. Here is the link to the product https://blendermarket.com/products/auto-rig-pro It's a great add-on for blender! Highly recommended! Rig is generated from ARP Smart feature, so you may need to tweak weightmaps to achieve your desired result.

  - Clothing is designed for the BodyHigh mesh.

  - The amount of polygons and vertices shows up in 3d model details is for only the Bodylow SDiv1 mesh, since this product's main feature is the base mesh.

  - All my models do not have a area.

Comment and like are welcome! Please check out other products in my account as well. Let me know if you have any questions.Thanks!

description_text:
A detailed and optimized model, perfect for VR and other fast paced or demanding games which need to retain high frames.
The package contains all texture necessary for PBR rendering.
Besides the emphasis on optimization, the model is also made to hold up even in Ray traced renders, which require higer quality standards.
Feel free to contact me at any time here on CG Trader.
All of the Textures are HD 2048x2048 JPEGs
All of them can be downscaled
Texture types:Diffuse, Normal, Specular, AO, Metalic, Emmisive
On this marketplace I generally strive for high-quality low poly / optimized models with a certain level of realism.
They are generally all made in the same style so that they may possibly be used in a single project without looking out of place.
This, as mentioned is best suited for current generation games, but the models should look and function for most projects, regardless of weather they are intended to be real-time or not.
Lastly, if yo have any personal inquiries or want to make contact regarding potential projects, here is my personal email:
milos.baskic98@gmail.com

description_text:
A fully Rigged (in Maya) Orc Ogre Creature ready to be animated. Compatible with Unreal Skeleton so you can use stock animations.
Comes with High detailed 4k Texture Maps of Albedo, Metal, Gloss, Normal and SubSurface. PBR Ready.

An Obj is also supplied for compatibility, OBJ's cannot contain skin or rig data, so it is purely the static mesh. Ideal for making texture adjustments.

description_text:
Highly-detailed original 3D model of a dark mage/necromancer. Aimed at PC projects. 
LOD versions are included to help reduce the polycount when the model is far away on screen. Certain parts of her costume can be disabled. You can remove such things as: horns, face mask, earrings, jewelry, etc to customize the look. 
This package includes textures for Unity, Unreal and Generic PBR.
Model has face, eyes, teeth and tongue. You can disable her teeth and tongue to reduce the polycount. NOTE: This model's body doesn't have forearms and feet. Works with standard Unity Metallic Shader. Sculpted in ZBrush, retopology in Zbrush, textured in Substance Painter, UV Unwrapping in Blender, rigging in Blender. Supports Mecanim and third-party animations. 
Polycount: 
LOD0: 82k triangles / 44k vertices 
LOD1: 51k triangles 
LOD2: 34k triangles 
Materials: 7 
Textures: 2048x2048 PNG 8BIT 
Textures include: Ambient Occlusion, Metallic, Diffuse(Color), Normal, Emission. 
Animations: no 
Sounds: no

A stone sculpture of an woman sculpted into a stone wall. Perfect for any jungle/temple environment with an Asian style. The model was scanned within the city of Angkor in Cambodia. That's the reason for the "Khmer" style sculpt. The model contains a High-Poly scan mesh as well as a game ready base and LOD model. Each with its own texture. All three models are PBR suitable.
Features:8k TexturesPBR readyGame-ready Base and LOD meshHigh-poly Scan meshAccurate Sizes of the meshClosed BottomDelighted Textures*The .STL includes all types (Highpoly,Base and LOD) in one File
Meshes:Highpoly-scanned-mesh (HP)Base-game-ready-mesh (Base)LOD-game-ready-mesh (LOD)
Texturepacks:HQ_Textures.zip (4k Diffuse, Normal, Displacement, Roughness for Base; Same textures in 1k for LOD)HP_Textures.zip (8k Diffuse, 4k Normal, 4k Roughness for High-Poly mesh)
The polycounts are (in verts):
HP: 776,625Base: 3856LOD: 537

thank you!
